name: split-monitor-workspaces
label: Split Monitor Workspaces
description: Provides independent workspace sets for each physical monitor (AwesomeWM-like multi-monitor workspace behavior).

options.label: Workspaces Per Monitor
options.description: Number of dedicated workspaces allocated to each monitor.

options.label: Keep Monitor Focused
options.description: Prevent cursor focus from jumping to another monitor when changing workspaces.

options.label: Switch Notifications
options.description: Show system OSD notification when switching split workspaces.

options.label: Persistent Workspaces
options.description: Keep all split workspaces created in waybar/dashboards even when empty.
